summary: Critical: .NET 9.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
.NET is a fast, lightweight and modular platform for creating cross platform applications that work on Linux, macOS and Windows.  It particularly focuses on creating console applications, web applications and micro-services.  .NET contains a runtime conforming to .NET Standards a set of framework libraries, an SDK containing compilers and a 'dotnet' application to drive everything.

SDK version: 9.0.122
Runtime version: 9.0.21

Security Fix(es):

* dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet: dotnet8.0: .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-58280)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet: .NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability (CVE-2026-66822)

* dotnet9.0: dotnet: dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-69651)

* dotnet8.0: dotnet10.0: dotnet: dotnet9.0: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70159)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70175)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70179)

* dotnet9.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet10.0: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70181)

* dotnet: dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet8.0: ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70183)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet8.0: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70186)

* dotnet: ASP.NET Core Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70188)

* dotnet9.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet10.0: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-70196)

* dotnet: ASP.NET Core Tampering Vulnerability (CVE-2026-88092)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet: MessagePack: Nested arrays can blow past buffer length limits (CVE-2026-92707)

* dotnet: dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet10.0: .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96225)

* dotnet9.0: dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: dotnet: ASP.NET Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96230)

* dotnet: dotnet9.0: dotnet10.0: dotnet8.0: .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96231)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet: dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96233)

* dotnet: dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet8.0: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96236)

* dotnet8.0: dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: .NET Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96237)

* dotnet8.0: dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet: .NET Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-96238)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Update .NET 9.0 to SDK 9.0.122 and Runtime 9.0.21 [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-277801)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
